reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was the QR on the box and every sachet that opens the batch lab report, plus the one-hand tear sachets that fit a carry-on. My doctor suggested magnesium for sleep and cramps, so I would try one box of the plain bisglycinate, but only one, since there are no reviews.
objection: A brand with zero reviews. Anyone can print a QR code, and I have no way to know the report is real or that the capsules match it until other buyers say so.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen verified reviews, or a sample-size trial price, before I commit to Subscribe & Save.
